python3 -c "
import math

# Rates as percentages
rate1 = 8.072  # 19-day bills
rate2 = 10.260  # 2-day bills

# Convert to decimal (not percentage)
rate1_decimal = rate1 / 100
rate2_decimal = rate2 / 100

print(f'Rate 1 decimal: {rate1_decimal}')
print(f'Rate 2 decimal: {rate2_decimal}')

# Log of each rate
log_rate1 = math.log(rate1_decimal)
log_rate2 = math.log(rate2_decimal)

print(f'Log rate 1: {log_rate1}')
print(f'Log rate 2: {log_rate2}')

# First difference
diff = log_rate2 - log_rate1
print(f'First difference: {diff}')

# Realized variance (squared difference)
variance = diff ** 2
print(f'Realized variance: {variance}')

# Round to nearest hundredths
print(f'Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(variance, 2)}')
"
